name: tables-evaluation
comment:overrides: glide-data-grid 6.0.3 — the current release — still caps its React peer at 18.x, so a plain `npm install` fails against the React 19 the TanStack demo brought in. The override pins its peer to the one React in this tree rather than installing a second copy or requiring --legacy-peer-deps on every clone. Recorded in the Glide demo's meta.notes as a real friction point. Rechecked 2026-11-20: glide-data-grid 6.0.3 is still the latest release and its React peer is still capped at 18.x, so the override stays. The second override points @perspective-dev/client's optional @duckdb/duckdb-wasm peer (^1.30.0) at the root copy: the root pins a 1.33.1-dev prerelease, which that range does not match under semver, so 5.9.x fails a plain `npm install` without it.
